findings.title: Missing default value for new speed parameter
findings.body: The `shippingCents` function now requires a `speed` parameter, but the call site in `src/checkout.ts` (line 15) does not provide it. This will cause a runtime error when the new version is used. Provide a default value or update the call site.

findings.title: Multiplication order reduces clarity
findings.body: The expression `ZONE_RATES[zone] * SPEED_FACTOR[speed]` multiplies the base rate by the speed factor. While mathematically correct, this order may confuse readers who expect the base rate to be the primary factor. Swap the operands to improve readability.

summary.problem: The new speed parameter in `shippingCents` lacks a default and the multiplication order reduces readability.
summary.done_well: The new `Speed` type and `SPEED_FACTOR` constant are introduced cleanly and the function signature is updated consistently.
